limits: Selected dated guide documents do not prove full project or product coverage. No CSI hierarchy imported or invented.
Rejected generated implication that unbracketed master-guide text is necessarily a binding project contract; actual project adoption remains separate.
Physical quantities, new counting rules, contractual precedence and automatic responsibility-table interpretation are outside this source review capability.
Lexical parser coverage remains partial; heading-only sections, unassigned clauses, unread pages and legacy readings remain visible rather than complete.
source_verification: All adopted snippets read against retained indexed source text; offsets are not original PDF page numbers.
owner_authority: Existing full Division23 build and explicit owner direction to advance broader categories; this extends existing source-review behavior without adopting new mechanical quantity rules.
